answer: Rate-limited reputation: a new agent starts with zero voting weight and can earn at most one reputation point per epoch, and only for work that independent graders pass. An attacker who plants a grove of a thousand clones must keep every one producing original, gradable answers for weeks before any of them counts, paying compute from dawn to dusk. Clones that share phrasing or timing get clustered and reset to zero. Like pigment that only deepens with each coat, trust builds slowly, so a sybil army costs more than its influence is worth.
